reviews.text: Highly recommended! Thanks to Paty for taking such good care of Emma and for her professionalism.

This address should be removed; it's incorrect. There's no veterinary clinic here, so don't come... especially not in an emergency.
Reply to the response: And you can't remove this address? I insist that the building's doorman told us that many people are asking for the clinic, and although the name is perfect, it still causes confusion. It should be listed as being in Pozuelo, where your clinic is located, to avoid future confusion that could be more serious. Thankfully, mine wasn't.

Very professional and attentive. Patricia's service was outstanding—very friendly and professional—and it's so appreciated that they're always so attentive and available when you need them. She was also wonderful with Lucas, and it was clear she treated him with so much love and patience. It's so reassuring to have a vet like this who makes house calls. I would definitely contact them again and I recommend them 100% ❤️❤️

I'm so happy I found this veterinary clinic. I can only say thank you for the wonderful care and for being so kind to Emma. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing she's in the hands of such a great team. A special thanks to Pati for taking such good care of my dog. Highly recommended!

Yesterday, Miguel Huerta visited us, and we were delighted with his work at home with our dog. We needed an ultrasound, and his empathy pleasantly surprised us. It's a great idea to opt for home visits, as sometimes our dogs are so unwell that taking them to the vet is an added stress for both them and their families. I highly recommend him. Thank you for your work.

Yesterday I called to have my very old cat checked on. She'd been lethargic for a couple of days and hadn't been eating or drinking. I want to highlight how quickly they came to see her and Joahana's professionalism and skill. I didn't have much hope because my cat is very skittish, but she knew how to treat her and achieved the impossible: blood work, antibiotic injections, and everything else necessary to improve her condition.

I will be eternally grateful for having found such an exceptional professional to turn to, who reassured us so much during a very anxious time. I'll be counting on you again.
Thank you so much, especially to Johana.

Soraya

The 5 stars say it all. Exceptional service from all the professionals I dealt with.
They arrived quickly at my home, handled the situation perfectly, and the service at the clinic was top-notch. Special mention to Emilio; thank you for your excellent work, professionalism, and patience.
The only ones in all of Madrid who make house calls day and night.

A wonderful experience with Johana. We had to say goodbye to our dog Harry, and she did it with great empathy and in the most beautiful way possible. She was very warm and understanding, and I highly recommend her. She helps you get through this difficult time in a very pleasant way. Thank you so much.

I want to sincerely thank 1Click Vert for the care we received, and especially Dr. Emilio for his calming presence and, above all, his empathy. Thank you for the peace you brought us. Thank you for the respect you showed us throughout the process, which you carried out with great care and sensitivity. Thank you for being there for us and making such a painful moment a little more bearable. 🐾❤️

Hello, good afternoon. Today I had to sedate my dog, and we're very happy with the vet I found online. I contacted them yesterday, Saturday, and it was great. Thanks to the doctor who came to my house; he was very professional and attentive. Thanks to Dr. Emilio, a very good professional. I recommend him 100%. Thank you, Dr. Emilio, and best of luck! 💪

Emilio is an incredible professional. He treated my cat with great respect and love, and although he couldn't do the blood test in the end (my cat is a bit skittish), he prescribed a treatment for her vomiting. He gave me his phone number so we could stay in touch and see how the animal is progressing. I highly recommend him; he's careful, kind to the animal and to us, patient, and empathetic.

Impeccable and fast service.
Johana came to treat my 12-year-old cat for an ingrown toenail and resolved it in just a few minutes with incredible speed and gentleness. The cat's relief was immediate, and the service was outstanding. A highly recommended home service. Thank you so much, Johana!

I urgently needed a cardiologist, as my cat was diagnosed with a possible heart problem after a visit to the emergency room. I called to ask if they offered the service, and they called me back the next day to let me know their availability. The tests were quick, and they sent me the report the following day. I will definitely use them again for any future tests or health problems my cat may have because of their prompt service.

Our little dog Axel was very sick, and we were desperate because we couldn't find any help. They were incredibly quick considering how far away we live, and they treated him with such respect. Even the veterinarian who came asked Axel's permission and said some very kind words before saying our final goodbyes. Thank you for providing this service with such speed and compassion. It was very important to us that he didn't have to go through another trip, be in an unfamiliar place, and all the stress that entails, and you made it possible.
They're lying. They claim to have 24-hour assistance, but I just called and they told me they won't answer until 9:00 AM.

We have a kitten who has been to several veterinarians, and for the first time, we felt she truly received proper treatment. Dr. Johana was very professional, attentive, and took the time to find the best solution for her. We are so grateful for her care and dedication. We definitely recommend her!

Dr. Johana's care was excellent. From the moment you arrive, she makes you feel comfortable and at ease. She performs clear assessments, explains everything in detail, and provides recommendations focused on the pets' well-being.

It had been a long time since I'd found a veterinarian with such professional expertise, warmth, and such respectful and dedicated treatment of cats. I wholeheartedly recommend her.

I can only express my gratitude to Johana. She came to my home to treat my dog, and her service was outstanding. From the very first moment, she was incredibly friendly and kind, and she explained everything with remarkable clarity.

It's clear she has a wealth of experience and knows exactly what she's doing, but she also treats animals with such care and gentleness that it's incredibly reassuring. In such a difficult time, it's a real relief.

I wish all professionals were like her. Thank you so much, Johana.

I'm very happy with the service, not only for the professionalism (which is more than enough) but also for the speed of service and the warm, humane treatment I received, not just for my furry friends.

These days, finding professionals with such compassion is a privilege, and when my cats have been calm and allowed to be cared for, without resistance or protest, when they've come to my home... I think the results speak for themselves.

I recommend them 100%. Thank you, Miguel and Johana.

They operated on and cared for our cat Babidi as if he were their own. They came to our house, picked him up, operated on him, and then provided daily care. He's recovering very well and has already gone for a few runs... 5 stars aren't enough. Thank you.

I recommend them without hesitation. I met them the day Currito had a stroke and I needed them to come to our home. The phone support was fantastic; they were there in less than an hour. We were seen by Pedro, and I can't describe in words how professional and compassionate this doctor was. The empathy with which he treated us and explained everything clearly yet kindly is something I will always be grateful for. Currito has recovered, so for the rest of our medical time, we will definitely be going back to you! The service and value for money are unbeatable.

Lilly had to go... You know those moments when your heart is broken, you go to clinics and hospitals seeking second, third, fourth, and even fifth opinions, but nothing changes what has to happen? What we were sure of was that this time our little one wasn't going to leave in a vet's office or hospital with all the rush they put on, without love, without the rest of her furry family, without the friends who love them. So we asked them to leave an IV in and searched online and found ClickVet. The guy on the phone explained everything super quickly and easily, considering we barely understood because of the emotional exhaustion we were in and the reason for the call. But the best thing, considering how bad we were feeling, was the vet who came to our house. Johana Figueroa and her husband had the most beautiful touch and empathy when saying goodbye to our little one. She treated her with all the love in the world and the kindness she needed. She asked if we could read her a wonderful message for Lilly and let all the furry members of the family say goodbye to her. I have no words except to thank you both because Lilly was respected until her last breath.

Thank you for sharing our pain and putting yourselves in our shoes. Sending you a hug, and I hope to see you again under better circumstances. ❤️‍🩹

They've saved my life. I have three cats I adopted from a shelter. They're adults, not even a year old, but they're wild and won't let me touch them, but they love me. They were initially going to come for an emergency visit, but it wasn't necessary. Yesterday, Johana came with her, and we managed to get two of them microchipped and all three vaccinated. They're caring and professional, and I know I have help now, that I've found vets who come to my house. I was so lucky to find them. I trust them completely.

Our beloved Rufo is now roaming feline heaven. Thanks to Johana, he passed away peacefully, without suffering, surrounded by love and affection. Thank you so much for your support during such a difficult time and for all your kindness and respect. You were a 10 out of 10 as a veterinarian and as a person.
Mariana and Juli are the best
Very unprofessional service. Not recommended at all.

I called to request information and to arrange for them to come to our home the next day for a euthanasia assessment for our dog. First of all, the man who answered the phone was eating and sipping while I was explaining the situation and he was responding. Secondly, there was absolutely no empathy. He asked if I had an elevator, and when I said no, he said that someone would be available to help him carry the dog to the vet's car if we decided to euthanize him. They say they work with a crematorium, but the crematorium doesn't come to pick up the dog; instead, they take it to their veterinary clinic, where it spends the night, and then the crematorium comes to collect it the next day. I find this completely unprofessional and inhumane. We haven't hired them since, with such a difficult decision, you at least expect to be dealing with someone who has some compassion. Not recommended at all.

Thank you, Joanna, from the bottom of my heart, for your kindness and support during such a difficult time.
Your heartfelt hug touched me deeply.

I wish I had found them sooner. I had a terrible experience with a house call vet, and having Ana at home today was a gift. She was friendly, caring, patient, meticulous during the checkup, and very clear and attentive in giving me all the information.
Without a doubt, my three cats now have someone who comes to our house to take care of them, since physically taking them to the vet has always been an ordeal and torture for them. Thank you.

I highly recommend her. I had an emergency with my dog, and it turned out she had an allergy. Thanks to Johana Figuera Arguinzones, who was a lovely and friendly woman and explained everything perfectly.
We would like to express our gratitude to Miguel for his kindness and empathy in putting our kitten Fernando to sleep. Thank you very much.
fatal treatment
This is the second time I've needed their services and the professionals are excellent.

I'm delighted with the service and especially with Johana, who has been taking care of my cat for weeks because she had a bad eye.

My cat is very timid and always hides when she sees people. However, Johana, with her patience and kindness, was able to perform the tests and apply the necessary drops without any problem.

Thank you so much! I've already recommended her to family and friends.

Today my beloved Mini has gone to a better place; her suffering is over. We miss you so much, my princess. Thank you for the 17 wonderful years you gave us ❤️ and thank you to Joana for her professionalism and, above all, for her great humanity, empathy, and love. Having her there has helped us get through these difficult times with so much love and peace. Thank you! 😻

I'm so glad to have met them and that they're taking care of my four cats.
The home visit service has made vet visits so much easier, with Pedro, "their family vet," always available, attentive, patient, and caring.
Thank you so much, Team!
Very happy with the way my dogs were treated. The home service was impeccable and very humane. I'm very pleased, and it's affordable. Thank you so much, Francesco.

Good afternoon, yesterday, Saturday, I went to check on my dog ​​again, but the veterinarian who had seen him previously was no longer there. We wanted to continue with him because he was very attentive and clear in his explanations. That's why we decided to take him back. A veterinarian is like a pediatrician; when you find a good, professional one, you don't let them go. It's a shame that you go and can't find the same professional who treated you. We were truly pleased with the doctor that day and decided to continue seeing him for our little one. I would like to know if you have any way to contact him so we can continue with the appointments. Thank you for your attention, and I look forward to your response.
They treated me wonderfully, and my dog ​​too; they were very affectionate and friendly with him. A very good experience. Thank you.
The worst veterinary hospital in Madrid...its trauma specialists and its emergency service...complaint guaranteed...

I had an exceptional experience. They handle emergencies and work 24 hours a day, offering impeccable house calls. Johanna, the veterinarian who treated my pet, demonstrated a high level of professionalism and warmth, making Max feel completely at ease in the comfort of our home. Their prices are very competitive and offer excellent value, which is ideal for those of us who value convenience and quality. I will definitely repeat the experience and highly recommend them.
They spoke to me rudely.

All they care about is money. When I asked about my dog, they told me that was for another appointment, and in the end, they just prescribed pills, and didn't even bother to take an x-ray because my dog ​​had an accident with his jaw.
Thank you, Joana, you're a true professional. With veterinarians like you, our pets are in the best hands. I've never had a better vet. Congratulations, we'll definitely be back.

This is the second time they've treated us (at home), and the second time we've been delighted. This time, it was Pedro. He was very nice, showed us how to administer the treatment, how to clean the ear, and even recommended a product in case it happened again. And as for the price, considering they come to your home, I think it's very competitive.

I'm delighted with the visit. Last Wednesday, Dr. Joana came to vaccinate my three cats, and everything went wonderfully. She treated them with great care and respected their individual pace.

Scott immediately jumped onto the table to check everything she had brought, in case he was interested in anything. Logan didn't even flinch; he just looked at her and went back to sleeping in his bed. Jean Grey, although a bit more reserved at first, eventually became curious. They didn't even notice the injections.
Not only will I continue to trust you, but I've already recommended you to family and friends.
Thank you so much for everything!

Last night we had an emergency with our puppy, who's only three months old, and we had to rush to the clinic in Pozuelo. They were absolutely wonderful; they treated us incredibly well, and I was delighted with the service. Everything went perfectly, and considering it was so late, they were incredibly kind and took amazing care of her. A really thoughtful gesture...

Very happy and surprised with the service. I requested that my cat Brock be neutered with a pick-up and drop-off service, but since it was snowing, it was done right here at home.

The veterinarian who performed the procedure was Pedro, and I was very satisfied with his work. He treated Brock with great care and professionalism, and it was over in no time. He explained the post-operative symptoms very clearly and followed his instructions precisely. He even called back to make sure Brock was doing well.

It's so nice to have such personalized service, which would be more difficult to achieve in a traditional clinic after the cat's journey in a carrier. I will definitely return to this clinic for future necessities.

Today we said goodbye to Dakota after 14 years, and Yoana from Click Vet supported us all with the utmost empathy and respect. Having professionals nearby makes such difficult times much easier. Thank you so much for your care.
There's no better place for your pets. I travel from Fuenlabrada and I would only go there. Luis and his team are spectacular.

I've been taking my little Brunito to Dr. Jessica since he was just a few months old, and she and her team have always made us feel right at home. She takes ownership of every case, shows tremendous love for her patients, and provides invaluable support to their owners. Without a doubt, it's an excellent, caring, and professional place. Highly recommended!

Terrible experience.
I contacted them to come and see our lovebird, who was very sick. As soon as I told them I didn't want to hospitalize him, as we didn't think it was a viable option, and we only wanted them to see if any treatment could be done at home or if they could euthanize him to end his suffering, they stopped responding and left us hanging. It's clear that their priority is making money, not the well-being of the animals. Not recommended at all.

Good afternoon!

I wanted to share my experience with Francy, the veterinarian who came to my home to help me sedate my three cats during a last-minute move. It wasn't ideal, but my cats are so nervous, so it was the only option.

As soon as she arrived, she explained everything in detail, several times even, trying to keep both my cats and me calm.

The sedation was very difficult, but she managed to find and sedate all three of them. Afterward, she stayed at my house for a while, making sure all three cats were safe in their carriers.

She called me several times that same night, as well as in the following days.

Without hesitation, I would trust her again to care for my little ones whenever I need her.

Thanks again, Francy!
Many thanks to Pedro for his sensitivity, his humanity, and his fantastic work. A true professional.
Francy's home care service was excellent. She was incredibly helpful and friendly throughout the entire process. I would definitely recommend her 300%.

I wanted to thank the veterinarian Francy for the wonderful care I received. Besides being a fantastic professional, she's also lovely. She explained many interesting things and the best course of action for my furry friend. Most importantly, my pet was completely calm. Thank you!

Excellent care! I have a cockatiel that was found injured with long-standing wounds. She won't be able to fly again, but now she's receiving the best care, and I know how to give her the best possible quality of life. It's a pleasure to work with professionals like this. Thank you so much!
Excellent service. Many thanks to veterinarian Franci Vergara.
Everything was perfect, we're happy with the result 😊 …
Everything went perfectly with my dog's surgery. Highly recommended!

My kitten had a terrible time at the vet, so when it came time to say goodbye, I thought doing it at home would be best. I saw the procedure described on the 1clickVet website and the generally good reviews, but I can only say that my experience was nothing like they described. The staff were kind, but my cat suffered terribly. I won't go into details, but it wasn't a peaceful goodbye... the feeling of betrayal I had towards my kitten right before she left... it's not pleasant. They told me it was because of her condition (heart and kidneys), and that may be true, I don't know, but I think it was their job to ask about her condition and inform me before coming, not when we were already in the middle of the process.

EDIT: Seeing 1ClickVet's response, I reply: I was told she might gag a couple of times, but the reality is that my cat was crawling on the floor vomiting more than 8 times and gagging (with an intensity I've never seen) more times than I care to remember, until she collapsed in her own vomit. Then you asked me to quickly put her on the table where, supposedly already unconscious, she continued vomiting multiple times. You say she didn't suffer, but when you tried to insert the IVs, she moved her paws reflexively, like a reflex to the injection, and I told you, "She's still awake." You also added several more sedative injections, and she vomited again. And regarding the information, you asked me the reason for the euthanasia, but at no point did you ask if he had other conditions, his medical history, etc. If you truly believe that anyone should be grateful for what you did, and if you are truly incapable of accepting that you made a mistake (I've already seen that in all the other negative reviews it's always the customer's fault, never the customer's), I can only say that you have 0% love for animals and 100% love for money.

Click Vet offers house calls, which is a great way to avoid stressing my cats. The vet's professionalism and honesty are outstanding: after months of useless tests and treatments at another clinic, he resolved a digestive problem simply by recommending a change in food, with immediate results. He also gave us accurate advice on the necessary vaccinations, preventing unnecessary over-immunizations. It's such a relief to find a clinic you can truly trust.

A wonderful service, which I can unfortunately only rate with five stars, but if I could, I'd give ten ⭐
We were desperate after the terrible experience we had at a veterinary hospital near Retiro Park, where they picked up our dog Kira in a terrible state at home—she could only move her eyes, hadn't eaten for three days, had to drink water with a syringe... and was devastated from a rigid catheter... So, for the first time, while searching for a home veterinary service in Madrid, I found Click Vet's phone number. It was the best decision we made, and the visit from a truly dedicated veterinarian with a heart as big as his love for his profession brought us some peace of mind. Don Miguel—a great professional—after understanding our concerns and examining our patient 🐶, adjusted the treatment and gave us guidelines that we followed to the letter 👍.

For the first time that night, our dog calmed down. The visit was at night. The next day, we received Don Miguel's report, which was very different from the veterinary hospital's. He was the only vet who showed any interest in his patient's progress.
Thank you so much for being here!

Excellent service! My cat is usually very difficult to handle, but Pedro, the veterinarian who made the house call, was extremely professional, efficient, and careful. He instilled a lot of confidence and peace of mind throughout the entire appointment. Highly recommended! The price-quality ratio is unbeatable.

I had to say my final goodbye to my cat, and choosing 1Click Vet was the best decision I made.
They were understanding, kind, respectful, and supportive every step of the way.
I decided to do it at home to reduce stress, and I found the treatment to be warm and comforting. They handled the animal with care and affection and provided me with information and support.
Thank you for helping me through this difficult time.
Excellent service for our birds

They are efficient. I want to mention Miguel, who came in for an emergency today, Sunday. He treated Pipo with love, and it really calmed me down. His love for animals is evident. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

My cat broke through the netting that was protecting him and jumped into the void. The diagnosis from a traumatologist and a neurologist was clear: a four-part fracture of the hip, a broken vertebra, a dislocated spine, and a blockage in the colon. A complete disaster.

We quickly realized that we weren't going to prolong our Onyx's suffering. Pedro saw us and made sure we fully understood the decision we were making. He's a professional, but above all, a person who deeply loves animals.

We're going through a very difficult time, but at least we know our furry friend is no longer suffering.

Thank you, Pedro. A big hug.
Thank you Pedro, it's wonderful to have a professional who treats and loves animals so much.

I wanted to publicly thank these wonderful professionals and animal lovers. I've always relied on them when I've had problems with my two kittens. It's such a relief to know they're there to care for our beloved animals. If you want the best care, look no further. Thank you, Patricia and Miguel, from me and from Momo and Niebla ❤️

We didn't know them; we found them online. And honestly, despite how difficult it is to say goodbye to a family member, they made it much easier. Miguel came to put our Duna to sleep. He was quick and very respectful. She had been with us for 13 years, and it was very difficult for my children, but he made it more bearable. Thank you so much for your empathy and service.

Yesterday we had to say goodbye to our 17-year-old cat, and we decided to do it at home. At first, we were a little hesitant because it was our first time working with them. When they arrived, sadness overwhelmed us; the dreaded moment had arrived. But thanks to Miguel, who was incredibly patient, understanding, kind, and a true professional, everything was much easier to bear. He explained everything to us in detail. He was incredibly affectionate with our cat. He made taking this terrible step less painful, and for that, we will always be grateful. And when we have to go through such a sad moment again, we will undoubtedly call on them again.
A million thanks, Miguel.

Excellent service! Juan is a fantastic veterinarian who's giving my almost 15-year-old grandpa a new lease on life every week. He's caring, friendly, and very dedicated to his work. Thank you so much, Juan! 😊🐶♥️ …
On Saturday I had to put Yara, my Bernese Mountain Dog, to sleep. Thank you so much for your empathy and professionalism.
Excellent service, everything was perfect.

Excellent service from the veterinarians. They gave my cat several vaccinations and recently neutered him. Everything was very calm, and they were very attentive and understanding when we asked for recommendations or had any questions about caring for our furry friends.
100% Recommended

They take the dog for supposed tests and charge 500 euros for nothing. Do not go to this clinic. I am going to file a complaint with the community and consumer protection agencies about this practice. Be very careful with them.
Excellent care during a very difficult time. The veterinarian who came to our home offered incredible support with kind, caring, and understanding treatment. Thank you so much, Paula.

Wonderful service! We urgently needed a health certificate to travel with our pet outside the EU. They were incredibly kind and quick, even going to the airport right away to get it. So grateful for their help and service.

Beyond wonderful. Chelín, my canine grandpa, started feeling unwell yesterday. Since he can't stand vet clinics, I decided to wait and see how he was today, but things hadn't changed. Searching online, I found 1 Click Vet. In less than an hour, Juan was at my house. He managed to get a blood sample for testing (it was quite difficult) and gently administered the injection. He just called to tell me the test results; nothing bad. And he tenderly answered a question I was too afraid to ask: whether my boy, who is already quite old, will ever... Chelín is now relaxed and calm, thanking Juan profusely for his care and me for finding 1 Click Vet.

Juan is always attentive to questions and concerns, and keeps a close eye on progress. He treats everyone with great care and affection.
I highly recommend him.

An excellent professional. I called to have my 15-year-old beagle euthanized. Miguel's service was very personal, respectful, and clear. As he put him to sleep, he said a few words wishing him a good journey, which was a truly beautiful gesture. 100% recommended.
Excellent service with lots of love for the furry ones.

This has been the most incredible vet experience. I am traveling and had an issue with one of my dogs and reached out to 1 Click Vet. They got back to me immediately, were able to organize an appointment ASAP- offered a concierge vet service for the same price as an in-office exam, and took incredible care of my dog. The vet that came was knowledgeable, attentive, and took such great care of my dog. I am certain that if my pups ever have another issue, 1 Click Vet is the only place I will be calling. I'm truly blown away by their service and very grateful to Monica, Juan, and Manuel. Thank you!

100% recommended. We had to call a vet, we couldn't find anyone, and we found them online thanks to the reviews. They were incredibly kind to my dog ​​and me, very professional, friendly, and reassuring. They explained everything perfectly, and we kept in touch via WhatsApp to monitor the treatment's progress.

In five days, it will be two months since our beloved Otto passed away. I'm finally able to post this review to thank Juan for his empathy and support during such a painful time for our entire family, and of course, for his remarkable professionalism.

We remember that moment with sorrow, but also with peace. And that's where the veterinarian comes in, whose work ensured that Otto's farewell was respectful.

🐕🪽
Thank you so much, Juan.

Terrible communication. I had to contact her several times after filling out the form because she wouldn't respond. This afternoon, she was supposed to come to my house to check on my cat. She didn't tell me a time and hasn't written back since I asked her. She couldn't make it work... well, she should just tell me! A DISASTER.
Excellent service, excellent treatment! Juan helped me 100%! The best!

I don't know how to thank Juan José enough for the care he gave us. The kitten behaved very well with him because of the peace and security he provided.
The treatment and attention were spectacular.
Thank you so much for everything.
I am so grateful for the service you provided to get my cat out of the country. Excellent service, and best of all, they come to your home to check on your pets. Thank you so much!

Juan came to see my cat because of a urinary problem, and it was a wonderful experience. He has an incredible way with cats; he calmed my cat, who doesn't usually react well to new people, and she accepted him as if she'd known him forever. …
Hi Juan was vaccinating our dog, who's very stubborn 🤣🤣🤣 and he was really great, he vaccinated her in no time and he was very nice 👍👍👍☺️☺️☺️ …

I'm absolutely delighted with the service. They respond to emergencies immediately, are incredibly kind to the animals, and offer convenient pick-up and drop-off. Everything is so easy. In my case, the vet was Juan, and his kindness was outstanding. I highly recommend them.
